sloka: विवृत्तनयनं क्रोधात् सफेनं रुधिराप्लुतम्।ददृशुस्ते विरूपाक्षं विरूपाक्षतरं कृतम् ।। ६.९७.३३ ।।
transliteration: vivṛttanayanaṁ krodhāt saphenaṁ rudhirāplutam।dadṛśuste virūpākṣaṁ virūpākṣataraṁ kṛtam ।। 6.97.33 ।।

translations.english: The Vanaras witnessed Virupaksha who had misshapen eyes, turning his eyeballs in anger, foaming blood flowing from nostrils.
